system: Loi n° 2024/017 relative à la protection des données à caractère personnel

fact: The authors say the Act provides for a supervisory authority, the Personal Data Protection Authority, and that it is yet to be established.
The OBS-CC observatory states that law no. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 institutes the Personal Data Protection Authority (APDP).
The OBS-CC observatory states that the APDP is not yet installed and that the implementing decree under article 53 has not been taken.
